title: Taxpayer-scoped assistant service in Frappe
scope: Serve the TAX-096 taxpayer-assistance operations from Frappe: authenticate the taxpayer session, build the assistant's permission-scoped inputs (own submissions, documents, validation results, taxpayer-facing requests), call the assistant runtime, store assistant drafts and provenance, and require explicit taxpayer confirmation before anything changes a submission or is sent to RSL

acceptance.text: A taxpayer can only obtain assistance for their own tenant and records; internal-only fields never leave the service (tests); confirmation is a separate, audited, idempotent step
Confirmed submissions and evidence responses enter the existing Frappe/Jube flow (TAX-039, TAX-045) unchanged; unconfirmed drafts never do
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Confirmed submissions and evidence responses enter the existing Frappe/Jube flow (TAX-039, TAX-045) unchanged; unconfirmed drafts never do

evidence.text: Observed 2026-11-12: vati_tax/assistance/service.py (Frappe-free) serves the five TAX-096 operations behind /api/v1 (backend.HANDLERS, operations.SERVED). Only a caller whose sole role in the header tenant is taxpayer (new taxpayer-only, taxpayer-owned action assistance.use) and only for its own taxpayer: staff/services/mixed roles 403 (ledger denied), another or unknown taxpayer 404, foreign submission 422 not_found, sent submission 422 submission_not_editable. The records port reads only own submissions, documents and taxpayer-facing request columns; the service re-filters. Every assistant answer is checked (status, closed schema, forbidden field names, own IDs, records unchanged) before it leaves, else 503. Confirmation is a separate, audited, idempotent step (expected_version, declaration, key replay/conflict, 409). Tests: assistance/test_service.py 17 OK; the TAX-102 gate through the service passes all 16 cases with the reference runtime and the 8 TAX-098 cases with the real assistant.

Observed 2026-11-12: confirmation calls the unchanged TAX-045 responses.store.respond (scope, evidence ownership and reuse, idempotency, request to responded, ledger); unconfirmed drafts never reach it (test_service DraftAndConfirmTests; bench test_draft_then_confirm_enters_the_tax045_flow_once written but not run, no Frappe site in this session). No assistance operation edits or sends a submission, so the TAX-039 flow is unchanged. Drafts are stored in the new Vati Assistance Draft DocType (System Manager read only).

Observed 2026-11-12: dev.py check, ruff check, mypy (346 files), contract.py and tests/contracts passed; evidence in docs/evidence/TAX-100; docs/PERMISSIONS.md updated. Bench tests (3) are written but not run: Docker unavailable here; run scripts/frappe_dev.py verify.
